description:
Sites allowed to call the database from a browser: list, add, remove.

    Addresses of the connected projects and their branches are allowed
    automatically — do not add them. An added site opens no data by itself:
    what can be read and written is decided by access levels. Adding and
    removing need the person's consent; a removed site is refused on every
    request. Needs a token with the admin scope.

action.description: `list` — addresses of the database's projects and the manually added ones; `add` — allow a site; `remove` — remove a site.
action.title: Action

confirmed.description: true — the person has already agreed in the chat after seeing what will change. A client with forms does not need it: the server asks the person itself. Never set it without the person's explicit consent.
confirmed.title: Confirmed

database.description: The database: name, slug or id. Without it — the organization's only database with the Data API enabled.
database.title: Database

note.description: For add: why the site was added.
note.title: Note

organization.description: Organization slug. Without it — the only one, or the personal one.
organization.title: Organization

url.description: For add and remove: the site origin with scheme, `https://shop.example`.
url.title: Url

name: data_api_origins
title: Data API базы: сайты
